prompt: YouTube (channel_id 5) ran in bursts: it had spend in January, June, August, September, October, November and December 2025, and in January, February, March, May, July, September and November 2024. How many rows does this query return?
shown_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  -- one row per month with YouTube spend
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE c.channel_id = 5
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT m.month, m.spend_eur, p.spend_eur AS spend_prev_year_eur
FROM monthly m
JOIN monthly p ON p.month = m.month - INTERVAL 1 YEAR
WHERE m.month >= DATE '2025-01-01'
